title: Merchandise Purchases — Finch Note Shortfall Refund: Figures and Working
content:
**Clause.** The Finch Note shortfall refund on a Merchandise Purchases unit is the note shortfall plus the capped note service credit plus the lapsed-note goodwill plus the member note courtesy, rounded half up to the cent, where:

- the **note due amount** is the unit's selling price plus the tax recorded on it, less the larger of the Finch Notes applied on its purchase record and the notes the ledger shows redeemed on it, and less the tax recorded on the part of the price paid by redeemed notes beyond those applied, which is the tax recorded on the unit times that part divided by the unit's selling price, rounded half up to the cent;
- the **note shortfall** is the total value of the notes the ledger shows redeemed on the unit less the Finch Notes the purchase record shows applied, but never more than the money captured on the unit by tenders other than gift cards (its payment captures less those made by gift card) less what those tenders should have paid (the note due amount), and never below zero;
- the **note service days** are the calendar days from the purchase date to the request date, not counting the purchase date, rounded down to a whole number of weeks and multiplied by seven;
- the **note service credit** is the daily note service rate of $0.10 times the note service days, and never exceeds the note service cap of $3.00;
- the **lapsed-note goodwill** is $0.00 and the **member note courtesy** is $0.00.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

Selling price $50.00, tax $4.00; the ledger shows a $10.00 note redeemed on the unit and the purchase record shows none applied; the card captured $54.00; purchase date 2 February, request date 1 March.

| Line | Working | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| Tax on the note's part | $4.00 times $10.00 divided by $50.00 | $0.80 |
| Note due amount | $50.00 plus $4.00, less $10.00, less $0.80 | $43.20 |
| Excess captured | $54.00 less $43.20 | $10.80 |
| Note shortfall | $10.00 less $0.00, not more than $10.80 | $10.00 |
| Note service days | 27 days after the purchase date, 3 whole weeks, times seven | 21 |
| Note service credit | $0.10 times 21, below $3.00 | $2.10 |
| Refund | $10.00 plus $2.10 plus $0.00 plus $0.00 | $12.10 |

## Reading the clause

- *Part of the payment by gift card (hypothetical):* if $20.00 of the $54.00 had been captured by gift card, the money captured by other tenders is $34.00, which is below the $43.20 due amount; the shortfall is then zero.
- *A long-standing purchase (hypothetical):* 70 note service days give $7.00 before the cap and $3.00 after it.
